dslRule:
<!id: file.createTempFile.deleteOnExit>
<!description: Ensure temporary files created with java.io.File.createTempFile are marked for deletion on JVM exit to prevent resource leaks.>
<!severity: HINT>

java.io.File $file = java.io.File.createTempFile($prefix, $suffix);
=>
java.io.File $file = java.io.File.createTempFile($prefix, $suffix);
$file.deleteOnExit();
;;
summary: Mark temporary files created with `File.createTempFile` for deletion on JVM exit using `file.deleteOnExit()`.

verification.message: Candidate DSL must contain only one rule and optional per-rule metadata; file metadata, includes, and embedded Java are not promotable
